python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing, ValidationError
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw, fields.String, fields.Integer):
        field = cls(load_default=7, dump_default=8)
        assert field.deserialize(missing) == 7
        assert field.serialize('value', {}) == 8
        assert field.metadata == {}
        assert cls().deserialize(missing) is missing
        assert cls().serialize('value', {}) is missing
        nullable = cls(load_default=None)
        assert nullable.allow_none and nullable.deserialize(None) is None
        assert cls(load_default=None, allow_none=False).allow_none is False
        assert cls(load_default=lambda: 9).deserialize(missing) == 9
        assert cls(dump_default=lambda: 10).serialize('value', {}) == 10
        repr(field)
        try:
            cls(required=True, load_default=1)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert 'load_default' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('required default accepted')
    class Child(Schema):
        value = fields.Integer()
    nested = fields.Nested(Child, load_default={'value': 1}, dump_default={'value': 2})
    assert nested.deserialize(missing) == {'value': 1}
    assert nested.serialize('child', {}) == {'value': 2}
    assert nested.deserialize({'value': '3'}) == {'value': 3}
    constant = fields.Constant(5, load_default=6, dump_default=7)
    assert constant.load_default == constant.dump_default == 5
    assert constant.deserialize(missing) == constant.deserialize(100) == 5
    assert constant.serialize('value', {}) == 5
    class Parent(Schema):
        raw = fields.Raw(load_default='load', dump_default='dump')
        child = nested
        no_dump = fields.String(load_default='only load')
        dynamic = fields.String(dump_default=lambda: 'dynamic')
        nullable = fields.String(dump_default=None)
    props = JSONSchema().dump(Parent())['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert props['raw']['default'] == 'dump'
    assert props['child']['default'] == {'value': 2}
    assert 'default' not in props['no_dump']
    assert 'default' not in props['dynamic']
    assert props['nullable']['default'] is None

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    legacy = fields.Raw(default=1, missing=2)
    assert legacy.dump_default == legacy.default == 1
    assert legacy.load_default == legacy.missing == 2
    legacy.default = 3
    legacy.missing = 4
    assert legacy.serialize('x', {}) == 3
    assert legacy.deserialize(missing) == 4
    preferred = fields.Field(default=1, dump_default=2, missing=3, load_default=4)
    assert preferred.dump_default == 2 and preferred.load_default == 4
    assert caught
print('Default API and consumer integration checks passed (new API warnings treated as errors).')
PY
